The actual `poll_feed` implementation always does `SimpleRSS.parse open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` and iterates all items, relying only on per-item `content_sha1` in TopicEmbed for change detection, with no feed-level caching/If-Modified-Since/ETag optimization evident in the diff.
